lines: Cross the line and Results opens: where you finished, and what to ride next.
Against bots it reads your place out of ten, in volt on the podium, with your time. Below, the final standings: every rider with a time, bots marked, your row current.
On a phone it's one column, the actions below the standings. From a tablet in landscape, what you earned sits beside them.
Finish sixth and it says how far off: twenty-seven thirty-two, eighteen seconds off the podium.
Against your best it shows the time. A class shows thirty minutes, three hundred forty-two kilojoules and eighty-four percent on target.
Done goes home. Race it again opens Race Setup with the same mode and pack; Ride it again, the class.
What the tests prove: a real race and class end on Results, every line of the view, and the way back.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
